name: eng-repo-governance
summary: Owns safe, auditable Git mutation and integration mechanics within one repository.
input_contract: Requested Git action, resolved exact targets and relevant refs, worktree/dirty ownership, scope and authority; project-selected remote-sync intent only for synchronization.
output_contract: Actual mutation and before/after evidence; optional version 2 repository slice with exact base/head and scope, branch/worktree and freeze/promotion evidence only when applicable.
